findings.detail: Distinct JV look-through investment rows were omitted even though the filing separately discloses them from the fund's direct positions.

rationale: Class 3 anchor-first review found filing total fair value of 82199.346 million versus extracted fair value of 80938.296 million. Raw source then localizes the coverage mechanism: ABG Intermediate Holdings 2 is disclosed twice with different acquisition dates, maturities, and values - a direct fund position at table 39 row 29 and a separate JV look-through position at table 281 row 16. The flagged JV-qualified position is therefore a real separately disclosed exposure, not a duplicate-name false alarm. The aggregate anchor supports incomplete coverage, although the cited row alone does not explain the full residual.
